about_the_game:
Return to the world of Meow Moments with our Music Festival DLC!


Join the celebration in a lively outdoor scene where cats and friends gather to enjoy music, creativity, and joyful moments. Explore a colorful festival filled with diverse vibes and shared experiences.

Groove at the pop stage, rock out with long-haired fans, sway to indie folk tunes, or dance under lights in the electronic tent. Beyond the music, discover food trucks, a dazzling Ferris wheel, cozy campgrounds, and stories unfolding across the entire event.

This DLC brings a burst of rhythm and energy to your Meow Moments experience. Let’s celebrate together at the Music Festival!

By purchasing this DLC, you can:
  • Play a brand-new scene in the main game.
  • Add the Music Festival content to your creations in the Community and Creative Maker. You can mix items from all the scenes you own in the same scene!
  • Play the scenes created by other players in the Community that include Music Festival items.

You will also support us to create more content and more games!
Thanks in advance! 🎶🐱
